g.text: One dot per generation: highest training score in the selected population; ties use fewer LOC.
Identical coordinates overlap (latest generation on top). Labels every 10 generations; shared labels mark the same point.
LOC excludes blank lines, comments, and docstrings. Thin lines connect generations in time order.
